did: Home now hands the Monday essay routine each week's final record through the mailbox. After a week's deadline, the next mailbox pass makes the week final on its own and puts the record as index-rust in the index folder, in the same shape the phone's record route answers. That's server#798; RR18 added the rust routine to the mailbox Worker first. Then, for RR17, server#800 added the missing EV5 test that a week let go is never given to the renderer again. It also showed that the suspected bug, a withdrawn week listed as waiting forever, isn't there, and pinned that with a test.

calls.title: How many weeks the rust index carries
options: Only the week that just went final
Every final week among the newest four weeks home holds
calls.why: The mailbox keeps only the latest index per routine, so a routine that missed a Monday would lose the week it still owes. Four weeks stays small and bounded per pass.

calls.title: RR17's suspected listing bug
options: Write a defect fix as asked
Pin the existing behaviour with a test, since the bug isn't there
calls.why: The video feed has left withdrawn weeks out since server#774, so there was nothing to fix. A defect commit would have recorded a failure that never happened.
calls.undo: None needed: it adds only a test.

left: The real proof of the rust index is w46: its record should reach the mailbox within about an hour of Sun Nov 15 23:59 Pacific, which no session has seen yet.
The suggested ledger wording for MI5, MI6, the mailbox store and EV5 went to the coordinator for the ledger session; I didn't land it myself.
